invariants.statement: Read-only mode registers exactly the tools its capability manifest names, all marked read-only, and no write tool
Write-enabled mode registers exactly the manifest's tools: the read tools plus propose, lease and transition, and only those three are not read-only
No tool in either mode accepts a credential-like argument (token, dsn, password, secret, credential, authorization, api key)
No registered tool name contains review, accept, dispute, import, provision or initialize
The anonymous read-only search returned only public records
Read-only mode acts as nobody; write mode reports a principal that lists no credential-like key
